title: What to expect from Invoices and Receipts

question.author: member_039
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for invoices and receipts?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: Invoices are issued monthly from the billing portal at the start of each cycle. You can download PDF receipts for the last 24 months, change the billing email, and switch between credit card and bank transfer (Business and Enterprise). Failed payments trigger a 14-day grace period before access is limited to view/download-only mode. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
